geometry_edits.rationale: Recompile the protected dominant mass with a stepped section family to strengthen section-program fit without breaking the ancestry.
Maintain the long-span horizontal direction so the new section remains a single readable mass rather than fragmented pieces.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the dominant mass toward a clearer inhabited terrace/profile that better supports neighborhood living while preserving the main bent-bar gesture.
Keep the section logic aligned with the long horizontal bar so the stepped profile reads as one continuous program volume.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent bent bar with a continuous stepped/curved section, and it is legible in all four views rather than only one. It sits within the parcel and does not visibly collide across views. The main weakness is programmatic ground response: the blue frontage edge is acknowledged by an adjacent void/cut condition, but the access relation remains somewhat muted and not fully public-facing. Still, for neighborhood living the mass plausibly supports a compact active-edge building with one clear upper articulation and a usable void, so it clears hard pass. The section is acceptable because the folded top and continuous profile give a reasonable inhabited/terraced logic without turning into an unrelated hall or tower.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More pavilion-like and curved than the candidate; do not copy the scalloped roof language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise massing with a strong carved central void and bridge-like upper connection can support a neighborhood program while keeping the ground legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger and more campus-like than the candidate; avoid spreading into disconnected blocks.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A courtyard-centered campus composition can organize multiple parts around a public middle while preserving hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is a civic/public building with a more rectilinear facade; the candidate should remain more compact and neighborhood-scaled.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A shallow recess, overhang, and clear cutout can create an active ground threshold without overcomplicating the mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is shorter and more compact; do not stretch it into a long campus bar.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Elongated low-rise massing with a carved atrium or court and a subtly folded roof can make a long horizontal building feel programmatic rather than generic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is more distributed and multi-winged; the candidate should not become fragmented.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced/connected masses around a void can produce a clear public core and an upper hierarchy that reads as inhabited landscape.
